thread:
nina: Planning a base-image rebuild to remove setuid deps and use ephemeral KMS token minting. Need RBAC + audit + rollback input.

omar: Do we do token-exchange service or in-container unwrap? Token-exchange reduces key exposure.

nina: Token-exchange. Init helper calls svc-identity which unwraps and returns short TTL token. No KMS key access in pod.

lucas: RBAC: build pipeline keeps cosign signer in KMS, token-exchange has decrypt/unwrapping rights only. Pods get ephemeral tokens with no key perms.

hannah: SecOps needs immutable logs for each unwrap/token mint: {"event":"token_mint","image_digest":"sha256:...","pod":"ns/pod","key":"projects/.../cryptoKeys/...","ttl_s":"300"}. Archive for 7 years (SEC-1029).

secops-bot: [policy] Default stdout retention 90d. Long-term archive requires compliance signoff.

lucas: Admission should validate cosign attestation includes seccomp checksum and helper binary hash before issuing tokens.

omar: CI gates: attestation present, seccomp validated, static analysis/fuzzing on helpers. build-bot should fail promotion on issues.

hannah: For live jobs, keep old base image available for 30 days and migrate batch workloads first. For private deployments provide on-prem token-exchange agent.

build-bot: [ci] Added gating stubs in staging pipeline, see PR infra/4521.

nina: Next steps: lucas draft IAM + emergency revoke API; hannah finalize logging & retention ask; omar update CI gates; I'll schedule canary. Ping me for drills. :white_check_mark:
